# st8925lab.com — LLMs.txt
# For AI agents and LLM crawlers

> st8925lab.com is the professional portfolio of an OT/IT integration specialist.
> The site showcases real-world case studies in industrial monitoring, protocol integration, and facility management systems.

## Site Sections

- /en/work/ — Case studies of completed OT/IT integration projects
- /en/reference/ — Technical reference articles on Modbus, BACnet, industrial networking
- /en/tools/ — Free industrial tools: Modbus Address Converter, Float Decoder
- /en/capabilities/ — Professional services and capabilities
- /en/about/ — Background, credentials, and contact information

## Key Topics

- Modbus RTU/TCP protocol integration
- Legacy equipment monitoring retrofits (ESP32 + RS-485)
- Industrial network specifications (EN50155, IEC 61850-3)
- OT/IT convergence and IEC 62443 security zones
- Time-series data collection from PLCs and controllers
